text:
Priya K.: Quick sync: NorthPoint wants clarification on the Gateway adapter contract + marketplace SKU mapping before they approve the SI playbook. Need to align on pricing band and hardware dependency notes.
Nate R.: Can you share the adapter API surface? NorthPoint flagged the auth handshake difference between our gateway and LangChain runner.
Owen D.: Adapter contract is here: https://internal.docs/integrations/gateway-adapter-spec. Main hooks: /attach, /route, /health. Auth uses signed JWTs.
Camille P.: For marketplace listing, we need clear "recommended infra" text: if partner uses SigmaCloud H100, call out improved throughput and recommended batch sizes. Also need SKU taxonomy: beta vs GA, per-hour vs reserved.
Victor (HW): From HW side — H100 quantized profile gives ~2x throughput on 8-bit INT8 for our reference model. But must call out that quantization impacts perf & determinism. We'll supply two benchmark artifacts.
NorthPoint SI: Can we get a sample deploy manifest? SI engineers want deterministic resource requests for smoke tests.
Owen D.: Sample manifest (K8s) below — it's minimal and used for demo smoke runs:
```
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: gateway-adapter-sample
spec:
  replicas: 1
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: adapter
        image: redwood/gateway-adapter:canary
        resources:
          limits:
            nvidia.com/gpu: 1
```
Camille P.: Marketplace-bot: any constraints on SKU names? We want something partner-friendly: "Gateway Adapter — LangChain Bridge (Partner) — Beta"
marketplace-bot: Reminder: SKU names must be <= 60 chars, avoid punctuation except hyphens, and include an internal tag like [partner:NorthPoint]. Use draft mode for partner-only listings.
Priya K.: Legal needs to sign off on co-branded clauses; LegalBot, can you queue the co-mark form and the partner T&Cs?
LegalBot: Co-mark request created (REQ-6734). Standard co-mark + trademark attachment required. Expect review in 48 hours.
Nate R.: Two technical asks from SI: 1) a fallback routing policy if hardware quota drops mid-demo; 2) a telemetry naming convention so they don't confuse our telemetry with their in-house traces.
Owen D.: For fallback routing we support policy chaining. Example config snippet:
```
routing:
  - policy: prefer_hardware
    fallback: cpu_quantized
```
We'll add a preflight check that fails the demo if quota < required.
Victor (HW): We'll add a reserved quota window for rehearsal + demo: request posted, but partners need to confirm in writing.
Camille P.: Marketing: do we announce partner name in Beta? NorthPoint wants joint landing page and marketplace blurb. Also need to confirm whether to use "powered by Redwood" or "integrated with Redwood" phrasing.
Priya K.: Legal note: "powered by" implies deeper endorsement; prefer "integrated with" unless we have co-signed collateral.
NorthPoint SI: We prefer "in collaboration with Redwood Inference" on joint page.
Priya K.: Good. Action: Legal will prepare a short co-mark copy and send to marketing.
Nate R.: One more: orchestration tools compatibility — does the adapter expose metrics in Prometheus format? SI ops need that for dashboarding.
Owen D.: Yes, /metrics endpoint exposes Prometheus metrics. We'll publish a metrics map doc for SI: adapter.metric., request.latency_ms, batch.size, model.variant.
Camille P.: For marketplace metadata we need to include: recommended model variants, quantization notes, expected latency bands on H100/A100, and a migration checklist for Dedicated -> Private deployments.
Priya K.: Suggest we create a single one-pager for partners summarizing: infra profile, SKU options, legal notes, telemetry, and runbook link. Camille, can marketing own that?
Camille P.: Yes — will draft the one-pager by EOD Tue. Will include Victor's benchmarks and Owen's manifest.
Victor (HW): Benchmarks attached will include p95 latency and tokens/sec for standard prompt mix. We'll sanitize customer-sensitive tags.
LegalBot: Co-mark form sent to NorthPoint PM. Request reply by EOD Wed to meet announcement timeline.
marketplace-bot: Draft listing created in "partner-drafts/1729"; set to partner-only visibility.
Priya K.: Proposed timeline: internal dry-run Fri 2024-03-15, partner rehearsal Mon 2024-03-18, marketplace partner preview Tue 2024-03-19, public beta announce Thu 2024-03-21. Any blockers?
Nate R.: Ops maintenance on Thu 03:00-04:30 UTC — should be fine. Just avoid that slot for any pushes.
NorthPoint SI: We'll confirm rehearsal availability by EOD. Also requesting a 30-min architecture sync with Owen and Victor.
Owen D.: I'll schedule the sync and attach an integration checklist (auth, metrics, fallbacks).
Camille P.: I'll prepare marketplace blurb + hero image placeholders (brand-compliant). Need approved co-mark copy to finalize.
Priya K.: Recap action items:
- LegalBot: finalize co-mark form + T&Cs (48h)
- Victor: share sanitized benchmarks (attached)
- Owen: publish manifest + metrics map + fallback config
- Camille: one-pager + marketplace blurb + imagery placeholders
- NorthPoint SI: confirm rehearsal time + sign co-mark form
marketplace-bot: Embargo rules: partner-only preview window for 72h before public listing.
Priya K.: OK locking to that timeline unless legal stalls. If co-mark not returned by Wed EOD we push public beta one week.
Nate R.: lgtm
Owen D.: ack
Camille P.: will post draft one-pager link here when ready
Victor (HW): will ping when benchmarks uploaded
NorthPoint SI: thanks team — we'll respond by EOD with availability
Priya K.: End thread — thanks all.
